EPIFIX is a medical device in Japan (Generic name: Material using human amniotic membrane for promotion of tissue healing) for use on intractable ulcers that are non-responsive to existing therapies for the purpose of promoting wound healing.
interventions.name: EPIFIX

identificationModule.briefTitle: Post-Marketing Surveillance of Dehydrated Human Amnion/Chorion Membrane (DHACM) in Non-Ischemic Chronic Wounds
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Post-Marketing Surveillance to Observe the Safety and Efficacy of Dehydrated Human Amnion/Chorion Membrane (DHACM) Wound Graft in the Management of Non-Ischemic Chronic Wounds

armGroups.description: Standard of care will be cleaning, debridement, ulcer moisture balance, and offloading.
armGroups.label: Standard of Care

armGroups.description: EPIEFFECT® is a PURION processed lyophilized human placental tissue allograft that includes the amnion layer, intermediate layer, and chorion layer of the amniotic membrane. The product is intended for use as a barrier to provide a protective environment in acute and chronic wounds.
armGroups.label: EPIEFFECT

armGroups.description: EPIXPRESS™ is a PURION processed lyophilized human placental tissue allograft that includes the amnion layer, intermediate layer, and chorion layer of the amniotic membrane. The product is intended for use as a barrier to provide a protective environment in acute and chronic wounds. EPIXPRESS is fenestrated to help facilitate fluid movement and can be used on wounds that produce copious amounts of exudate.
armGroups.label: EPIXPRESS

interventions.description: Beginning at the screening visit, participants will receive weekly treatment with standard of care (cleaning, debridement, ulcer moisture balance, and offloading) until ulcer closure, or a maximum of 12 weeks, whichever occurs first.
interventions.name: Standard of Care

interventions.description: Participants will receive weekly applications of EPIEFFECT and Standard of Care until ulcer closure, or a maximum of 12 weeks, whichever occurs first
interventions.name: EPIEFFECT

interventions.description: Participants will receive weekly applications of EPIXPRESS and Standard of Care until ulcer closure, or a maximum of 12 weeks, whichever occurs first
